articles.summary: Ramon Sanchez will oversee a broader scope as Firefly’s COO including the company’s day-to-day operations to support company growth.
articles.title: Ramon Sanchez Joins Firefly Aerospace as Chief Operating Officer

articles.summary: Hosted on Firefly’s Blue Ghost lander, Volta’s LightPort will demonstrate technologies to survive the lunar night and support a lunar power grid.
articles.title: Firefly Aerospace Adds Volta’s Wireless Power Receiver to Blue Ghost Mission on Far Side of the Moon
